༄༅/ /zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil chog don gnyis myur 'grub zhi khro'i dbang phreng la sbyor tshe bum bskyed kha bsgyur bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil chog don gnyis myur 'grub zhi khro'i dbang phreng la sbyor tshe bum bskyed kha bsgyur bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ye/ dgongs pa yang zab kyi zhi khro'i dbang chog chen mo byed skabs/ mdun bskyed ni zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil chog don gnyis myur 'grub dkyus kho na ltar byas pas grub la/ bum bskyed ni bum pa mang nyung dang thod pa sogs bca' gshom mi 'dra bas lha bskyed lugs kyang khyad par che bas 'di ltar sbyar ro// bsangs sbyangs| stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa rnam rgyal lnga dang*/ khrus bum dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa rnams las/ rnam rgyal bum pa lnga'i nang dang bum mtshan so so'i dbus kyi bum par seṅge'i khri steng pad zla'i gdan la 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ shar gyi bum par glang po'i khri steng pad zlar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ lho'i bum par rta mchog gi khri steng pad zlar rin po che ser po trāṃ gis mtshan pa/ nub kyi bum par rma bya'i khri steng pad zlar pad+ma dmar po hrīḥs mtshan pa/ byang gi bum par shang shang gi khri steng pad zlar rdo rje rgya gram ljang gu āḥs mtshan pa rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyangs/ tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan rnams la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad ces pa nas/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs zhes pa'i bar dkyus ltar dang*/ bum pa'i steng gi thod pa lnga po so sor dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang rab tu brjid pa'i nang du sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i rgya mtshor 'khyil ba re rer gyur pa'i thod pa dbus ma'i nang du tshangs pa pad nyi'i gdan la bud+dha he ru ka zhes sogs dkyus ltar la/ rtsibs shar du sogs dor nas/ shar kyi thod par dri za pad nyi ces bsgyur ba nas/

me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs par gyur/ ces dkyus ltar la/ khrus bum gyi nang du/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhi 'dzum phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dpe rdzogs shing rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs kyis bklubs pa/ las bum gyi nang du pad nyi rgya gram gyi gdan la hūm̐ las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang sngon ces pa nas/ de ltar gsal ba'i lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ ces pa nas/ rang rtags kyi phyag rgyas dbu brgyan par gyur gyi bar dkyus ltar la/ bstod pa'i tshe/ khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun// rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang*// phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la// zhes dang*/ las kyi rigs las khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil/ sogs nas// las rab rdzogs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstod par 'os pa thams cad/ sogs nas// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ sngags kyi 'od zer gzung thag la 'khril te song*/ bum thod kyi lha rnams kyi thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ so so'i sku las bdud rtsi bab pas bum thod rnams khengs par gyur par bsam/ zhi khro'i bzlas pa bya/ khrus bum la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes dang*/ yig brgya bzla/ las bum la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs/ mthar bum thod kyi lha rnams bde stong chen por 'od du zhu ba bum chu dang thod pa'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ khrus bum gyi rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas dag byed kyi bdud rtsis bum pa khengs par gyur par bsam/ las bum la/

dpal khro bo'i rgyal pos 'dir ji srid dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs rnams srung zhing bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig |ces brjod cing me tog 'thor/ slar bum thod kyi lha thams cad thun mong du nyer mchod lngas mchod do/ /'di ni zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil chog don gnyis myur 'grub zhi khro'i dbang phreng la sbyor ba'i tshe bum bskyed kyi kha bsgyur du/ gter gzhung gi zhi ba rigs bsdus kyi phyi sgrub dang*/ rje rat+na'i ljags bsgrigs zhi khro'i dbang phreng gnyis bstun nas bklag chog 'khyer bder zur bskol du bris pa yin gyi/ rang bzo'i gya tshom rtog brtags shes 'dod kyi dri ma nam yang med do/ */ zhes pa'ang shing lug rang lo re gcig pa'i steng ston ra khrum stod can gyi dmar po'i stong pa dang po la gzhu stod gter sgrom drag po'i gnas chen gyi 'dabs rgyal dbang rat+na'i mtshan can gyi dben gnas 'brong ngur gyi gzim spyil du 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas bris so// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
